```python
def fixed_point(g, x0, tol=0.0001, maxiter=100):
    sequence = [x0]
    for _ in range(maxiter):
        next_x = g(sequence[-1])
        step = abs(next_x - sequence[-1])
        sequence.append(next_x)
        if step < tol:
            return sequence
    raise RuntimeError('Step tolerance not reached')
```
